pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pPeriodically attempts accelerated growth on a nearby eligible plant.$p$(l)Set up and operate$()$p1. Place it within the configured range of crops.$p2. Allow the growth interval to elapse.$p3. Check plant eligibility, maturity and the protected-callback policy.$p$(l)When it does not run$()$pOne interval attempts a bounded growth action; it does not instantly grow every plant in the area.$pRead the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.$pActual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pCrafting / obtaining this machine: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:troubleshooting/no_progress)General operating checklist$()
